regions.name: The Crossroads
regions.description: A leaning gallows marks where four mud roads meet. Crows watch from the beam, patient as debt collectors.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.description: Black pines crowd the path. The wind speaks your name, then laughs at it.

regions.name: Bone Quarry
regions.description: White dust coats everything. The stone here was never stone — it was cut from something that once had a heartbeat.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: Pews float in knee-deep black water. The bell still tolls at midnight, though no rope remains.

regions.name: Hollow Keep
regions.description: A fortress gutted from the inside. Banners of a forgotten house rot on the walls; something heavy paces the upper floor.

regions.name: Cinder Crypt
regions.description: The air burns your lungs. Ash falls upward here, and the dead do not stay in their alcoves.
